title: Smiling Girl in Sun Hat & Toddler, Dirt Yard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny Depression-era snapshot featuring a smiling young girl standing in a dry, unpaved yard. She wears a wide-brimmed cloth hat and a light-colored button-up house dress. In the background behind her, a small toddler wearing a dark hat sits quietly on the dirt slope. A modest white wooden structure and sparse trees sit further back on the property.
